programme.title: Munna Baba(dub) (unakaga Ellam Unakka Tamil)
programme.desc: Sakthi, a rich spoilt brat falls for Indhu. His father, Vinu meets his friend Jayaganesh and they agree on a marriage proposal for their children. Sakthi wants to break the deal because he loves Indhu and wants to marry her, but he does not realise that Indhu is Jayaganesh's daughter. He tries to break the engagement by asking his cousins to misbehave and indulge in a fight. Ultimately in the end, the two get married.

programme.title: Omkara
programme.desc: A crime drama based on William Shakespeare's play "Othello". The film follows Omkara, a powerful and feared gangster who trusts his lieutenant , Langda more than anyone. However, Langda plots against Omkara, manipulating him into believing his wife has been unfaithful. The film explores themes of jealousy, betrayal, and revenge, and features powerful performances and intense action sequences.

programme.title: Lucky-No Time For Love
programme.desc: A story of Lucky, a yound girl who is taken in by a wealthy family in Russia after being orphaned in war-torn Afghanistan . While adapting to her new surroundings, she meets a man who is initially distant and unapproachable, but eventually spend more time together and form a deep bond. Despite facing cultural differences and other obstacles, their love perseveres as they strive to be together.

programme.title: Ye Kaisa Pal Do Pal Ka Pyar
programme.desc: Gangotri Pictures Pvt. Ltd's Ye Kaisa Pal Do Pal Ka Pyaar is a love story that's set in a village. Seema (Lovely Joshi), who is a daughter of a high caste Pandit Deendayal, falls in love with an educated Dalit boy Nikhil (Uttam Kumar. When Pandit Deendayal doesn't approve of their love, the two lovers elope, only to be chased by Pandit Deendayal's henchmen, whom Nikhil kills one by one. Amidst all this, there is also a parallel story that speaks of an enmity between Pandit Deendayal and Thakur Surendra Singh Rana, whose enmity gets further fanned up by two villagers Abdul and Malkhi.
